programmes.d: MacGyver and bounty hunter Jesse Colton search the streets of Bangkok for Colton's illegitimate son, whom they suspect has information concerning stolen medical supplies.
MacGyver and Murdoc are forced into an uneasy partnership when they must rely on each other's resources in order to rescue a kidnap victim -- Murdoc's sister.
MacGyver helps a dissident Chinese student who is being pursued by Chinese government agents.
Five-O has 12 hours to find a test tube filled with the deadly Q strain, which science genius Alex Kline has hidden.
A high-voltage jewel thief in the guise of a socialite sets out to steal a treasured gem belonging to Hawaiian royalty.
Five-O is confronted with the problem of corralling foreign agents responsible for critically wounding a U.S. government undercover agent upon his return from a 10-year mission in Red China.

Contaminated heroin shatters a failing singer's desperate attempt at a comeback. Caught in the same quagmire of crime is the singer's drummer friend who dies from the toxic dope; Mike, who offers much needed help to McGarret.
McGarrett must thwart an elaborate assassination attempt on the life of a self-exiled Greek doctor.
MacGyver teams up with a female archaeologist, Zoe Ryan, in the search for an ancient artifact known as 'The Holy Rose.'
